description: Road Crash Data is a dataset listed in Australian Government open data portal (data.gov.au), an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Infrastructure and Transport. Details of reported road crashes and casualties in South Australia. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Infrastructure and Transport. Its tags are car, casualties, casualty, crash, cyclist. It offers 14 resource(s) in csv, pdf. The portal shows 2025-12-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
